simple.meaning: חֶמְאָה (chemʼâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “curdled milk or cheese.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 18:8. The surrounding context includes flock, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶמְאָה (H2529) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חֶמְאָה (chemʼâh) / H2529 is traced through Genesis 18:8, Deuteronomy 32:14, Judges 5:25, 2 Samuel 17:29 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

timeline.evidenceText: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
butter from the herd, and milk from the flock,
honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David, and for the people who were with him, to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
He will not look at the rivers,
when my steps were washed with butter,
For as the churning of milk produces butter,
He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter; for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

definitions.full: H2529. chemah חֶמְאָה noun feminine curd ; — ׳ח Gen 18:8 6 t.; = חֵמָה Job 29:6 ; construct חֶמְאַת Deut 32:14 ; curd, curdled milk , modern labben ח יוֺצִיא חָלָב ׳מִיץ Prov 30:33 , elsewhere joined with חָלָב Gen 18:8 (J) Deut 32:14 (poem; צאֹן וַחֲלֵב בָּקָר חֶמְאַת ), Judg 5:25 (where served אַדִּירִים בְּסֵפֶל , see ספל ); with דְּבַשׁ 2Sam 17:29 ; Isa 7:15 , 22 (twice in verse); compare וח דבשׁ ׳נַחֲלֵי figurative of abundance Job 20:17 ; בְּחֵמָ֑ה חֲלִיכַי בִּרְחֹץ 29:6 (|| יָצוּק צוּר ׃ מַּלְגֵישָֽֿׁמֶן ). **On mode of making lebben , by shaking milk in sour milk-skin, see Doughty Arab. Des. i. 221, 263; ii. 304, etc. Thomson Land and Book ii. 418 See also ARSK Ency. Bib. MILK .
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) חֵמָה ; from the same root as 2346 ;
